description: This file defines event handlers and event argument classes related to gateway connection events within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes delegates for handling connection loss and gateway count changes, as well as a class encapsulating the event data for gateway count changes.

classes.name: GatewayCountChangedEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments class that provides information about the current and previous number of connected gateways, and indicates if the connection was recovered.

methods.name: GatewayCountChangedEventArgs
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event arguments with current and previous gateway counts.
